description:
Capmind connects your personal recordings and meeting intelligence to ChatGPT.

Use Capmind to search your past recordings, retrieve transcripts and summaries, review key decisions, and find action items from conversations stored in your Capmind account.

Capmind only accesses data belonging to the authenticated user. The app is read-only and does not create, edit, delete, publish, or share recordings on the user’s behalf.
